redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.desc: While equipped: spend one action to restore 10% of your maximum Life, rounded down. Costs no Mana; 4-second cooldown. Only usable while injured.

details.treeSummary: Hover, focus, or tap a node to preview its current and next-level power.
details.currentEmpty: Spend a point to unlock current stats.
details.descriptionSummonPreparation: {{skill}}: once at each wave start, if learned, unlocked and in your combo, fill missing living summons up to {{count}} for one payment of {{mana}} MP for the whole batch. Already full: no cost. Not enough mana: no summons or payment, and no retry that wave. This skill uses no ordinary action; fallen summons are not replaced and return no mana. Each new wave starts with fresh summons, paid from your carried mana.

magic-arrow.name: Magic Arrow
magic-arrow.desc: Fires an arcane-imbued arrow that costs no ammunition.

multiple-shot.name: Multiple Shot
multiple-shot.desc: Fires a spread of arrows hitting up to 5 enemies in a cone.

freezing-arrow.name: Freezing Arrow
freezing-arrow.desc: Fires a frozen arrow that explodes in a cone, chilling and sometimes freezing enemies.

lightning-fury.name: Lightning Fury
lightning-fury.desc: Hurls a lightning javelin that splits and chains to all nearby enemies.

plague-javelin.name: Plague Javelin
plague-javelin.desc: Throws a javelin that releases poison clouds, applying 3 stacks of poison and spreading on kill.

strafe.name: Strafe
strafe.desc: A rapid volley of arrows that strikes all enemies in combat.

critical-strike.name: Critical Strike
critical-strike.desc: Automatically adds {{bonus}} percentage point of critical hit chance per allocated rank (maximum {{cap}} ranks).

penetrate.name: Penetrate
penetrate.desc: Automatically increases your equipment-derived Attack by {{bonus}}% per allocated rank (maximum {{cap}} ranks).

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.desc: Automatically adds {{bonus}} percentage point of physical dodge chance per allocated rank (maximum {{cap}} ranks).

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.desc: Summons a Valkyrie warrior to fight at your side.

fire-arrow.name: Fire Arrow
fire-arrow.desc: Fires a flaming arrow that burns the target.

cold-arrow.name: Cold Arrow
cold-arrow.desc: Fires an icy arrow that chills the target.

exploding-arrow.name: Exploding Arrow
exploding-arrow.desc: Fires an arrow that explodes on impact, hitting multiple enemies.

ice-arrow.name: Ice Arrow
ice-arrow.desc: Fires an icy arrow that freezes the target.

guided-arrow.name: Guided Arrow
guided-arrow.desc: Fires a seeking arrow that never misses.

immolation-arrow.name: Immolation Arrow
immolation-arrow.desc: Fires an explosive arrow that leaves a pyre, burning enemies over time.

jab.name: Jab
jab.desc: A quick javelin thrust that hits multiple times.

power-strike.name: Power Strike
power-strike.desc: A lightning-charged javelin attack that releases bolts on impact.

poison-javelin.name: Poison Javelin
poison-javelin.desc: Throws a javelin that releases a poison cloud.

impale.name: Impale
impale.desc: A powerful javelin thrust that ignores defense.

lightning-bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning-bolt.desc: Hurls a javelin charged with lightning energy.

charged-strike.name: Charged Strike
charged-strike.desc: A melee attack that releases lightning bolts to nearby enemies.

fend.name: Fend
fend.desc: A defensive flurry that strikes all surrounding enemies.

lightning-strike.name: Lightning Strike
lightning-strike.desc: A javelin attack that chains lightning between enemies.

inner-sight.name: Inner Sight
inner-sight.desc: Reduces enemy defense, making them easier to hit.

slow-missiles.name: Slow Missiles
slow-missiles.desc: Reduces the speed of enemy projectiles.

avoid.name: Avoid
avoid.desc: Automatically adds {{magicDodge}} percentage point to magical dodge per allocated rank. Amazon only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.desc: Creates a duplicate to distract enemies.

evade.name: Evade
evade.desc: Automatically adds {{physicalDodge}} percentage point to physical dodge and {{magicDodge}} percentage point to magical dodge per allocated rank. Amazon only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave.

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.desc: Automatically increases direct physical damage by {{damage}}% and equipment-derived Attack by {{attack}}% per allocated rank. Attack bonuses add with Penetrate. Amazon only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave.

shock-web.name: Shock Web
shock-web.desc: Lays a web of crackling lightning that paralyzes all enemies in combat.

fire-blast.name: Fire Blast
fire-blast.desc: Throws an explosive fire trap that bursts in a cone, burning enemies.

blade-fury.name: Blade Fury
blade-fury.desc: Hurls a flurry of blades in a cone, striking multiple enemies.

mind-blast.name: Mind Blast
mind-blast.desc: Releases a psychic shockwave that burns mana and stuns all enemies.

dragon-claw.name: Dragon Claw
dragon-claw.desc: A pair of swift claw strikes against a single target with bonus crit chance.

phoenix-strike.name: Phoenix Strike
phoenix-strike.desc: A combo strike that releases fire, cold, and lightning charges on a single target.

claw-mastery.name: Claw Mastery
claw-mastery.desc: Automatically active with a one-handed claw in the main weapon slot. Each rank adds {{attack}}% Attack and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

weapon-block.name: Weapon Block
weapon-block.desc: Automatically active with two distinct one-handed weapons and learned Claw Mastery. Each rank adds {{physicalDodge}} percentage points of physical dodge and {{magicDodge}} percentage points of magical dodge; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

fade.name: Fade
fade.desc: Automatically active for the Assassin. Each rank adds {{resist}} resistance points to all six damage types and {{magicDodge}} percentage points of magical dodge; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

venom.name: Venom
venom.desc: Automatically active for the Assassin. Each rank adds {{poison}}% poison damage. Each successful basic hit applies one poison stack for {{seconds}} seconds: {{coating}}% Attack per second, increased by poison damage bonuses, then reduced by poison resistance and armor; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

tiger-strike.name: Tiger Strike
tiger-strike.desc: First charge-up strike that adds damage.

cobra-strike.name: Cobra Strike
cobra-strike.desc: Charge-up attack that steals life and mana.

dragon-tail.name: Dragon Tail
dragon-tail.desc: An explosive kick that hits multiple enemies.

dragon-flight.name: Dragon Flight
dragon-flight.desc: Teleports to an enemy and kicks them.

psychic-hammer.name: Psychic Hammer
psychic-hammer.desc: Knocks back enemies with psychic force.

burst-of-speed.name: Burst of Speed
burst-of-speed.desc: A paid cast grants +{{speed}}% Attack Speed and +{{dodge}} percentage points of physical dodge per rank for {{seconds}} seconds. Put this skill in active priority. It cannot refresh while active; after expiry it can cast again if mana and cooldown allow. Allocation changes apply next wave; a paid effect keeps its cast rank. Unlocks at level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks.

cloak-of-shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloak-of-shadows.desc: Blinds nearby enemies and provides defense.

shadow-warrior.name: Shadow Warrior
shadow-warrior.desc: Summons a shadow copy that uses your skills.

shadow-master.name: Shadow Master
shadow-master.desc: Summons an advanced shadow that uses skills independently.

charged-bolt-sentry.name: Charged Bolt Sentry
charged-bolt-sentry.desc: Deploys a trap that fires charged bolts.

blade-sentinel.name: Blade Sentinel
blade-sentinel.desc: Releases a spinning blade that patrols the area.

lightning-sentry.name: Lightning Sentry
lightning-sentry.desc: Deploys a trap that shoots lightning.

wake-of-inferno.name: Wake of Inferno
wake-of-inferno.desc: Lays traps that release streams of fire.

death-sentry.name: Death Sentry
death-sentry.desc: Deploys a trap that shoots lightning and explodes corpses.

blade-shield.name: Blade Shield
blade-shield.desc: Surrounds you with spinning blades that damage attackers.

bash.name: Bash
bash.desc: A powerful single-target strike with the equipped weapon.

double-swing.name: Double Swing
double-swing.desc: Two cleaving strikes that hit up to 3 enemies.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Spins through enemies, dealing physical damage to all targets.

leap-attack.name: Leap Attack
leap-attack.desc: Leaps to a new position and lands with crushing force, stunning all nearby enemies.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc: An arcane-fueled rage strike that converts physical damage to arcane.

war-cry.name: War Cry
war-cry.desc: A devastating shout that damages and stuns all enemies.

iron-skin.name: Iron Skin
iron-skin.desc: Passive: +{{bonus}}% ordinary defense per allocated skill rank (up to +{{maxBonus}}% at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}.

natural-resistance.name: Natural Resistance
natural-resistance.desc: Automatically adds {{resist}} percentage points to all six resistances and {{magicDodge}} percentage points to magical dodge per allocated rank. Barbarian only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks.

battle-orders.name: Battle Orders
battle-orders.desc: At combat start, increases max HP and mana by 50%.

shout.name: Shout
shout.desc: At combat start, grants self and mercenary +50% defense for 5 turns.

stun.name: Stun
stun.desc: A stunning blow that knocks back the target.

double-throw.name: Double Throw
double-throw.desc: Throws two weapons simultaneously at enemies.

concentrate.name: Concentrate
concentrate.desc: A focused attack with increased damage and defense.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.desc: Dual-wield attack that increases speed with each hit.

sword-mastery.name: Sword Mastery
sword-mastery.desc: Automatically active for a Barbarian with a sword in the weapon slot. Each rank adds {{physical}}% direct physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

axe-mastery.name: Axe Mastery
axe-mastery.desc: Automatically active for a Barbarian with an axe in the weapon slot. Each rank adds {{physical}}% direct physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

mace-mastery.name: Mace Mastery
mace-mastery.desc: Automatically active for a Barbarian with a mace in the weapon slot. Each rank adds {{physical}}% direct physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance; maximum {{cap}} ranks, unlocked at level {{level}}. Changes apply next wave.

pole-arm-mastery.name: Pole Arm Mastery
pole-arm-mastery.desc: Automatically adds {{physical}}% physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance per rank while a polearm is equipped in the weapon slot. Unlocks at level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Changes apply from the next wave.

throwing-mastery.name: Throwing Mastery
throwing-mastery.desc: Automatically adds {{physical}}% physical damage and {{speed}}% attack speed per rank while a throwing weapon is equipped in the weapon slot. Unlocks at level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Changes apply from the next wave.

spear-mastery.name: Spear Mastery
spear-mastery.desc: Automatically adds {{physical}}% physical damage and {{critical}} percentage points of critical chance per rank while a spear is equipped in the weapon slot. Unlocks at level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks. Changes apply from the next wave.

increased-stamina.name: Increased Stamina
increased-stamina.desc: Automatically increases equipment-derived combat maximum life by {{life}}% per allocated rank. Barbarian only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Learning does not heal during an encounter.

increased-speed.name: Increased Speed
increased-speed.desc: Automatically increases equipment-derived attack speed by {{speed}}% and adds {{physicalDodge}} percentage points to physical dodge per allocated rank. Barbarian only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks.

howl.name: Howl
howl.desc: Frightens enemies, causing them to flee.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Taunts enemies, forcing them to attack you.

grim-ward.name: Grim Ward
grim-ward.desc: Creates a totem from a corpse that frightens enemies.

battle-command.name: Battle Command
battle-command.desc: Increases skill levels for you and allies.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.desc: Summons a storm of fire that strikes all enemies and applies burn.

arctic-blast.name: Arctic Blast
arctic-blast.desc: Exhales a cone of freezing wind, chilling enemies hit.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.desc: Summons a swirling tornado that tears through enemies in a cone.

summon-dire-wolf.name: Summon Dire Wolf
summon-dire-wolf.desc: Summons a fierce dire wolf companion to fight at your side (max 3).

werewolf-maul.name: Werewolf: Maul
werewolf-maul.desc: Transforms into a werewolf and rends a single enemy, causing them to bleed.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.desc: Summons a hurricane that batters all enemies with cold winds.

elemental-mastery.name: Elemental Mastery
elemental-mastery.desc: Automatically increases fire and cold damage by {{elemental}}% and adds {{dodge}} percentage point to magical dodge per allocated rank. Druid only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave.

lycanthropy.name: Lycanthropy
lycanthropy.desc: Increases max HP by 50% while in werewolf form.

heart-of-wolverine.name: Heart of Wolverine
heart-of-wolverine.desc: Aura: increases attack speed of self and allies by 30%.

oak-sage.name: Oak Sage
oak-sage.desc: Aura: increases max HP of self and allies by 50%.

molten-boulder.name: Molten Boulder
molten-boulder.desc: Rolls a boulder of lava that burns enemies in its path.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.desc: Opens a volcanic fissure that erupts with flame.

cyclone-armor.name: Cyclone Armor
cyclone-armor.desc: Surrounds the druid with a protective cyclone.

twister.name: Twister
twister.desc: Summons small tornadoes that knock back enemies.

volcano.name: Volcano
volcano.desc: Creates a volcano that spews fire.

armageddon.name: Armageddon
armageddon.desc: Calls down meteors from the sky.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.desc: Transforms into a werewolf, gaining attack speed and damage.

werebear.name: Werebear
werebear.desc: Transforms into a bear, gaining life and defense.

feral-rage.name: Feral Rage
feral-rage.desc: A savage attack that increases life and speed with each hit.

maul.name: Maul
maul.desc: A powerful bear attack that stuns the target.

rabies.name: Rabies
rabies.desc: Bites an enemy, spreading disease that chains to others.

fire-claws.name: Fire Claws
fire-claws.desc: Ignites claws with fire, adding fire damage to attacks.

hunger.name: Hunger
hunger.desc: An attack that steals life from enemies.

shock-wave.name: Shock Wave
shock-wave.desc: Slams the ground, stunning all nearby enemies.

fury.name: Fury
fury.desc: A rapid series of werewolf attacks.

raven.name: Raven
raven.desc: Summons ravens to blind and attack enemies.

poison-creeper.name: Poison Creeper
poison-creeper.desc: Summons a vine that poisons enemies.

summon-spirit-wolf.name: Summon Spirit Wolf
summon-spirit-wolf.desc: Summons spirit wolves to fight for you.

carrion-vine.name: Carrion Vine
carrion-vine.desc: Summons a vine that consumes corpses to restore life.

solar-creeper.name: Solar Creeper
solar-creeper.desc: Summons a vine that consumes corpses to restore mana.

spirit-of-barbs.name: Spirit of Barbs
spirit-of-barbs.desc: Summons a spirit that reflects damage.

raise-skeleton.name: Raise Skeleton
raise-skeleton.desc: Prepare skeleton warriors; no corpse is required.

corpse-explosion.name: Corpse Explosion
corpse-explosion.desc: Requires an enemy monster to die in this wave first. Consumes one shared corpse and {{mana}} MP to deal {{min}}–{{max}} {{type}} damage to all remaining enemies and apply {{ignite}} on hit. Cooldown: {{cooldown}}. With no corpse, the combo skips this skill. Corpses clear between waves; consumption leaves normal kill rewards unchanged.

poison-nova.name: Poison Nova
poison-nova.desc: Releases a nova of toxic energy, applying 2 stacks of poison to all enemies.

bone-spear.name: Bone Spear
bone-spear.desc: Hurls a piercing bone spear that ignores armor and deals arcane damage.

amplify-damage.name: Amplify Damage
amplify-damage.desc: Curses all living enemies, reducing physical resistance by {{reduction}} percentage points for {{duration}} at every skill rank.

decrepify.name: Decrepify
decrepify.desc: Curses all enemies, reducing their attack speed by 50% and damage by 33%.

summon-mastery.name: Summon Mastery
summon-mastery.desc: Automatically grants newly created skeletons, skeletal mages, golems and revived minions +{{life}}% maximum life and +{{attack}}% Attack per allocated rank. Adds to local mastery bonuses. Necromancer only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave; existing summons stay unchanged.

poison-mastery.name: Poison and Bone Mastery
poison-mastery.desc: Automatically increases poison damage by {{poison}}% and arcane damage by {{arcane}}% per allocated rank. Necromancer only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave. Existing hit-derived poison damage over time includes the bonus once.

blood-golem.name: Blood Golem
blood-golem.desc: Always-on aura: 10% of damage dealt is returned as life.

bone-armor.name: Bone Armor
bone-armor.desc: Automatic: gain {{absorb}} absorption per rank at the next fresh area run (character level {{level}}, maximum {{cap}} ranks). Your personal pool blocks direct and periodic damage after mitigation and does not refill between waves. Learning or upgrading applies to the next fresh area run. It does not heal or increase maximum life.

teeth.name: Teeth
teeth.desc: Fires a volley of bone shards at enemies.

poison-dagger.name: Poison Dagger
poison-dagger.desc: A melee attack that applies deadly poison.

bone-wall.name: Bone Wall
bone-wall.desc: Creates a barrier of bone to shield from attacks.

poison-explosion.name: Poison Explosion
poison-explosion.desc: Requires an enemy monster to die in this wave first. Consumes one shared corpse and {{mana}} MP to deal {{min}}–{{max}} {{type}} damage to all remaining enemies. Hits apply {{poison}}; fresh {{poison}} lasts {{duration}}, up to {{stacks}} stacks. Reapplication refreshes the stack duration and retains the first damaging rate. Cooldown: {{cooldown}}. With no corpse, the combo skips this skill. Corpses clear between waves; consumption leaves normal kill rewards unchanged.

bone-prison.name: Bone Prison
bone-prison.desc: Traps an enemy in a cage of bone.

bone-spirit.name: Bone Spirit
bone-spirit.desc: Summons a seeking spirit of bone that tracks down enemies.

skeleton-mastery.name: Skeleton Mastery
skeleton-mastery.desc: Passive: Newly created skeleton warriors and mages gain +{{life}}% maximum life, +{{attack}}% Attack and +{{defense}}% ordinary Defense per allocated skill rank (up to +{{maxLife}}%/+{{maxAttack}}%/+{{maxDefense}}% at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}.

clay-golem.name: Clay Golem
clay-golem.desc: Summons a slow but durable clay golem.

golem-mastery.name: Golem Mastery
golem-mastery.desc: Passive: Newly created Clay, Blood, Iron and Fire Golems gain +{{life}}% maximum life and +{{speed}} flat Attack Speed per allocated skill rank (up to +{{maxLife}}% life and +{{maxSpeed}} Attack Speed at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}.

raise-skeletal-mage.name: Raise Skeletal Mage
raise-skeletal-mage.desc: Each fresh batch assigns mages Fire → Cold → Lightning → Poison, repeating from Fire. Their basic attacks deal direct damage of their assigned element. No corpse is required; these attacks do not automatically apply statuses or damage over time.

summon-resist.name: Summon Resist
summon-resist.desc: Automatically grants newly created skeletons, skeletal mages, golems and revived minions +{{resist}} percentage points to physical, fire, cold, lightning, arcane and poison resistance per allocated rank. Requires Golem Mastery and its Clay Golem prerequisite. Necromancer only, level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. Applies from the next wave; existing summons stay unchanged.

iron-golem.name: Iron Golem
iron-golem.desc: Sacrifice one explicitly chosen metal backpack item and 35 MP at a new wave start to prepare one Iron Golem for that wave. It inherits only the item’s Life, Attack and Defense.

fire-golem.name: Fire Golem
fire-golem.desc: Summons a flaming golem that burns enemies.

revive.name: Revive
revive.desc: Prepare Revived Minions whose strength grows with skill rank. No corpse or fallen enemy is required. They last until they or their summoner die, or the wave ends.

dim-vision.name: Dim Vision
dim-vision.desc: Blinds enemies, preventing them from seeing the caster.

iron-maiden.name: Iron Maiden
iron-maiden.desc: Curses enemies to reflect physical damage back to attackers.

terror.name: Terror
terror.desc: Causes enemies to flee in fear.

confuse.name: Confuse
confuse.desc: Causes enemies to attack each other.

life-tap.name: Life Tap
life-tap.desc: Curses enemies; damage dealt to them heals the attacker.

attract.name: Attract
attract.desc: Curses an enemy, causing others to attack it.

zeal.name: Zeal
zeal.desc: A flurry of melee strikes that hits up to 3 nearby enemies.

holy-bolt.name: Holy Bolt
holy-bolt.desc: Fires a bolt of holy energy at a single enemy, healing the caster for 50% of the damage dealt.

blessed-hammer.name: Blessed Hammer
blessed-hammer.desc: Summons spinning hammers of blessed energy that ignore magic resist.

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.desc: A righteous strike that deals fire, cold, and lightning damage simultaneously.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Charges a target, dealing heavy physical damage and stunning for 1 turn.

fist-of-heavens.name: Fist of the Heavens
fist-of-heavens.desc: Calls down lightning from the heavens, paralyzing all enemies.

might.name: Might
might.desc: When selected, each rank grants you and your living fielded mercenary +{{physical}}% physical damage and +{{attack}}% Attack, up to +{{maxPhysical}}% and +{{maxAttack}}% at rank {{cap}}. Changes apply from the next wave.

holy-fire.name: Holy Fire
holy-fire.desc: Aura: deals 20 fire damage per turn to all enemies and applies burn.

conviction.name: Conviction
conviction.desc: Select for the next wave: while the source hero lives, reduces all six enemy resistances by {{enemyResistReductionPct}} percentage points, including below zero. Allied summons also benefit from the enemy debuff. Per rank, the hero and originally fielded living mercenary gain elemental damage +{{elementalDamagePct}}% and arcane damage +{{arcaneDamagePct}}%. Requires level {{level}} and Sanctuary; maximum {{cap}} ranks.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.desc: Selected aura: adds {{bonus}}% of your normal mana regeneration per second per allocated rank to you and your living fielded mercenary (up to {{maxBonus}}% at rank {{cap}}). Each recipient retains their own normal recovery. Unlocks at character level {{level}}.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.desc: Powerful melee attack that damages the caster.

smite.name: Smite
smite.desc: Shield bash that stuns the target.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.desc: Converts enemies to fight for you temporarily.

holy-shield.name: Holy Shield
holy-shield.desc: Enhances shields with holy power, increasing defense and blocking.

blessed-aim.name: Blessed Aim
blessed-aim.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{attackPct}}% Attack to basic attacks and Attack-scaled skill damage.

concentration.name: Concentration
concentration.desc: Aura: increases physical damage and prevents interruption.

holy-freeze.name: Holy Freeze
holy-freeze.desc: Select for the next wave: while the source hero lives, chills every enemy, reducing Attack Speed by {{chillSlowPct}}%. Ordinary Chill and mercenary Holy Freeze share one slowdown. Per rank, the hero and originally fielded living mercenary gain cold damage +{{coldDamagePct}}% and Physical Dodge +{{physDodgePct}} percentage points. Requires level {{level}}; maximum {{cap}} ranks. A mercenary aura grants its separate party cold bonus.

holy-shock.name: Holy Shock
holy-shock.desc: Aura: damages nearby enemies with lightning.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.desc: Aura: damages and repels undead enemies.

fanaticism.name: Fanaticism
fanaticism.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{physicalDamagePct}}% physical damage and +{{attackSpeedPct}}% attack speed.

prayer.name: Prayer
prayer.desc: Aura: slowly heals you and nearby allies.

resist-fire.name: Resist Fire
resist-fire.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{resistAllPct}} percentage point to all six resistances and +{{fireDamagePct}}% fire damage.

defiance.name: Defiance
defiance.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{defensePct}}% Defense before enemy defense reductions.

resist-cold.name: Resist Cold
resist-cold.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{resistAllPct}} percentage point to all six resistances and +{{coldDamagePct}}% cold damage.

cleansing.name: Cleansing
cleansing.desc: Aura: reduces duration of poison and curses.

resist-lightning.name: Resist Lightning
resist-lightning.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{resistAllPct}} percentage point to all six resistances and +{{lightningDamagePct}}% lightning damage.

vigor.name: Vigor
vigor.desc: Aura: increases stamina and movement speed.

redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.desc: Aura: absorbs corpses to restore life and mana.

salvation.name: Salvation
salvation.desc: Selected aura: each rank grants +{{resistAllPct}} percentage points to all six resistances and +{{elementalDamagePct}}% fire, cold and lightning damage.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.desc: Selected aura: each rank reflects {{thornsPct}}% of physical Life actually lost by a surviving recipient. Reflection is mitigated as thorns and cannot reflect again.

ice-bolt.name: Ice Bolt
ice-bolt.desc: Hurls a single bolt of ice at an enemy, dealing cold damage and chilling them.

frost-nova.name: Frost Nova
frost-nova.desc: Releases a burst of cold radiating outward, chilling all enemies and freezing some.

frozen-orb.name: Frozen Orb
frozen-orb.desc: Hurls an orb of cold that pierces enemies and showers shards in a cone.

chain-lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain-lightning.desc: Releases a chain of lightning that bounces between up to 5 enemies, paralyzing them.

fire-ball.name: Fire Ball
fire-ball.desc: Lobs an exploding fireball that deals high single-target fire damage and burns the target.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: A meteor deals {{min}}–{{max}} {{type}} damage over an area. On a successful hit, applies {{burn}} then {{melt}}. {{melt}} reduces ordinary Defense by {{reduction}}% for {{duration}} at every skill rank.

cold-mastery.name: Cold Mastery
cold-mastery.desc: Passive: Your direct cold hits ignore {{base}} percentage points of enemy cold resistance at rank 1, plus {{growth}} per additional rank ({{max}} at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}. Applies only to you.

lightning-mastery.name: Lightning Mastery
lightning-mastery.desc: Passive: +{{bonus}}% direct lightning damage per allocated skill rank (up to +{{maxBonus}}% at rank {{cap}}). Unlocks at character level {{level}}. Paralyze is unchanged.

fire-mastery.name: Fire Mastery
fire-mastery.desc: Passive: +4% fire damage per allocated skill rank (up to +80% at rank 20). Unlocks at character level 30 and adds to Warmth’s fire bonus.

energy-shield.name: Energy Shield
energy-shield.desc: Diverts 30% of incoming damage to mana instead of life.

frozen-armor.name: Frozen Armor

ironGolem.title: Iron Golem sacrifice
ironGolem.rules: The golem expires at wave end. It inherits only the chosen item's Life, Attack and Defense, without set combination bonuses.
ironGolem.timing: Arming does not reserve or consume the item. Moving, equipping or discarding it may invalidate the instruction. Loading a save clears the instruction.
ironGolem.acknowledge: I understand: if Iron Golem prepares successfully in the next new wave, this item will be permanently consumed.
ironGolem.notArmed: No item armed for the next new wave.
ironGolem.armedInvalid: The armed instruction is no longer eligible: {{reason}}
ironGolem.previewScope: Current and next totals include this item once, then current eligible Golem Mastery. Attack Speed is flat. These live previews can differ from the recorded attempt and do not guarantee preparation or payment.
ironGolem.configurationUnavailable: Learn Iron Golem and its prerequisite, meet its level requirement, and add it to Active Skill Priority before arming.
ironGolem.armDone: Instruction armed. The item has not been consumed.
ironGolem.noAttempt: No recorded attempt for this hero.
ironGolem.summoned: {{item}} was sacrificed to prepare Iron Golem for this recording ({{mana}} MP).
ironGolem.notPrepared: Iron Golem was not prepared in this recording. No sacrifice was charged for this attempt.
ironGolem.unverified: The sacrifice outcome is unverified. Review the recovery controls in Combat.
ironGolem.pendingPaid: {{item}} was sacrificed ({{mana}} MP); the recorded wave still needs publication. Review Combat recovery controls.
ironGolem.pendingNoDebit: The recorded wave still needs publication. This attempt has no additional item debit. Review Combat recovery controls.
ironGolem.replay: This is a replay; it consumes no additional sacrifice.
ironGolem.locked: This wave keeps its original Iron Golem result. Skill, rank, equipment and item changes apply from the next new wave.
ironGolem.unlocked: Iron Golem added now waits for the next new wave; replaying this wave cannot add a sacrifice.
